description:
Recover deleted and lost files from hard drives, SSDs, USB flash drives, memory cards and CDs/DVDs.

DiskMend is a data recovery tool for Windows. It scans internal and external drives, USB flash drives, memory cards and CDs/DVDs for deleted and lost files, including drives that show up as RAW or ask to be formatted.
It reads NTFS, FAT/FAT32 and exFAT file tables, as well as APFS and HFS+ (Mac) disks, to bring files back with their names and folders, and finds photos, videos, documents and archives by their content when the file table is damaged.
The source drive is only read, never written to. Scanning and previews are free; saving recovered files requires a license (lifetime or one year).
